name: SLOOP
description: A live groovebox: tracks, layers, a step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples, played on the FM-1 in real time.

name: Felucca
description: The custom firmware the others build on: the FM-1's own synth engines, a sequencer, effects and a better panel, with an editor in the browser.

name: FM1 Stock
description: M-VAVE's factory firmware for the FM-1: eight voices sharing twenty notes of polyphony, each with its own sound, MIDI channel, level, pan and fine tune, a 64-step sequencer with per-step ratchets and an 8-track by 8-section pattern arranger, and 128 shared FX chains under MIDI control.

name: FM1 Open
description: M-VAVE's open-source firmware and SDK for the FM-1: eight tracks, eight sample slots, a 128-voice DX7 library with SysEx import and export, step recording, PLAY track roles that keep their sound across project changes, tap tempo with a synchronized delay and full MIDI routing, plus a browser workbench.

name: ChoralRoot
description: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.

name: FM-1+VA
description: A live-performance rebuild of the FM-1: a Virtual Analog engine with seven-oscillator super stacks, drift and zero-delay-feedback filters, an 8-bit chiptune engine with drums, sound effects and 31-shape arpeggios, a 64-step sequencer with per-step ratchet, chance, gate and parameter locks, patterns chained into songs, and four knobs on every screen.
